item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 26/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be very hot over Guangdong today and tomorrow. Thundery showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A broad trough of low pressure will affect the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next couple of days, an area of low pressure may form over it during the weekend. The broad trough of low pressure is expected to move northwards gradually towards the coast of southern China in the middle to latter parts of next week, bringing showers to the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will weaken and move across the seas east of Taiwan towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands today. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Francisco will move across the East China Sea and gradually dissipate.
